fields.q: 爱娜特莉亚对我总是很凶。你觉得她是在跟我调情吗？
fields.en: Anatolia's always so hard on me. You think it's her way of flirting with me?
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 爱娜特莉亚对我总是很凶。你觉得她是在跟我调情吗？

en.value: Anatolia's always so hard on me. You think it's her way of flirting with me?

fields.q: 建筑怎么搭的，我看一眼就知道。你呢？
fields.en: I can tell how a building is put together with just a glance. What about you?
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 建筑怎么搭的，我看一眼就知道。你呢？

en.value: I can tell how a building is put together with just a glance. What about you?

fields.q: 我爹妈都不在了，但我不怎么寂寞。我可比谁都强！
fields.en: My parents are gone, but I don't really feel lonely. I'm stronger than anyone, ya know!
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 我爹妈都不在了，但我不怎么寂寞。我可比谁都强！

en.value: My parents are gone, but I don't really feel lonely. I'm stronger than anyone, ya know!

fields.q: 饿肚子会让人难过。你要是需要吃的，跟我说一声。
fields.en: Being hungry can make ya sad. You ever need food, you let me know.
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 饿肚子会让人难过。你要是需要吃的，跟我说一声。

en.value: Being hungry can make ya sad. You ever need food, you let me know.

fields.q: 村里的人总是饿着肚子。我想让大家想吃就能吃上饭。
fields.en: Everyone in the village is always hungry. I wanna make it so they can all eat whenever they want.
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 村里的人总是饿着肚子。我想让大家想吃就能吃上饭。

en.value: Everyone in the village is always hungry. I wanna make it so they can all eat whenever they want.

fields.q: 在村里的时候，我们会抓沙虫来吃。下次给你带点！
fields.en: Back in the village, we hunted and ate sandworms. I'll bring you some sometime!
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 在村里的时候，我们会抓沙虫来吃。下次给你带点！

en.value: Back in the village, we hunted and ate sandworms. I'll bring you some sometime!

fields.q: 我看得出你对我有兴趣。我长得帅嘛，不怪你！
fields.en: I can tell you're interested in me. I'm a good-lookin' guy, so I can't blame ya!
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 我看得出你对我有兴趣。我长得帅嘛，不怪你！

en.value: I can tell you're interested in me. I'm a good-lookin' guy, so I can't blame ya!

fields.q: 不是针对你，你看起来不太好吃，全是骨头。我把你留到最后。
fields.en: Nothing personal, but you don't really look that tasty. You're all bones for one thing. I'll save you for last.
fields.name: 大刀

q.value: 不是针对你，你看起来不太好吃，全是骨头。我把你留到最后。

fields.q: 跟你说，我挺喜欢你的。要不要加入大刀帮？我很强，会罩着你！
